purpose: Authored inline symbols for the bounded Jacqueline and Tony experiments. Artwork remains external; identity does not establish publisher authority.
extraction: Verify the entire bundle before using its fixed LZMA block. Insert decoded_length as an eight-byte little-endian integer after the block's five property bytes, decode LZMA-alone, then verify the font slice. In memory only; no archive writes or generic Unity importer.

horror.evidence: Outlined brain visually compared with the archive resource explicitly named Horror; no explicit source-script mapping was found. Distinct from Q (heart) and S (solid brain silhouette).

wild.evidence: Rendered outline matches the stylized question mark on Promise of Power. This inline mark omits the card skill pip's diamond background.

curse.evidence: Rendered three-hook outline matches the inline curse mark in Promise of Power's rules text. SCE luckyPenny UI uses zy for bless/curse; z is the star mark.

presentation: One monochrome outline supports light and dark text colors. Prefer at least 24px for the thinner curse mark. Missing or changed artwork uses English labels, never literal font-code letters. No loose TTF/OTF/WOFF/SVG files were found in the archive.
